verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform that runs workflows, background processes and agents, so documented CPU and wall-clock execution limits are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack states any CPU time, wall-clock or timeout limits for workflow tasks or services. The marketing claim about deploying 'reliable agents and background processes at scale' gives no concrete limit figures, so there is no way to tell whether long-running workloads would fit.
